## Checklist

For wiki page additions / edits:

- [ ] Frontmatter `type:` matches the folder.
- [ ] At least one citation with `<source-slug>#para-N` (or `#page-N` as fallback).
- [ ] At least one `[[wikilink]]` to another wiki page.
- [ ] All wikilinks resolve to existing pages (or are intentionally placeholder — flag below).
- [ ] If a new frontmatter field is introduced, named here: <!-- list or "none" -->
- [ ] If a new taxonomy value is introduced, named here: <!-- list or "none" -->
- [ ] If conventions changed, `wiki/CONVENTIONS.md` updated in the same PR.
